page_title: MET 2-1 LEN | Metz v Lens 12/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Substitution. Lamine Camara (Metz) in, Danley Jean Jacques out.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

88' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
87' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fali Cande (Metz) replacing Kevin N'Doram.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Abou Lo (Metz) coming on for Ismael Traore.

83' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
80' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
78' Today's referee Romain Lissorgue rightly decides to book Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) for his harsh tackle.
77' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
74' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) for a tough tackle.

73' Florian Sotoca (Lens) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
72' That will be all from Neil El Aynaoui who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
69' Florian Sotoca (Lens) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
67' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.

66' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.

65' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Metz.
63' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Adrien Thomasson (Lens) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Angelo Fulgini (Lens) for Andy Diouf.
60' Substitution. Jonathan Gradit will be replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
60' The substitution has been made. Elye Wahi (Lens) has replaced Wesley Said.
59' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Deiver Machado is replaced by Jhoanner Chavez (Lens).
59' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
57' The corner from Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is cleared away by the defence.
56' Pape Diallo (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Metz will take a corner.
54' Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight and sees a foul from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).

52' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Georges Mikautadze (Metz) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
50' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

48' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Brice Samba has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
46' A yellow card for a tackle by Deiver Machado (Lens). Romain Lissorgue doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' 2 - 1 GOAL! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Brice Samba, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:1.
45+1' Andy Diouf (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Romain Lissorgue ignores the protests.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lens, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
44' Romain Lissorgue has issued a yellow card to Jonathan Gradit (Lens).
44' Romain Lissorgue shows the yellow card to Ismael Traore (Metz) for a heavy challenge.
42' The resulting free kick from Georges Mikautadze (Metz) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
39' Matthieu Udol (Metz) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

38' Kevin Danso (Lens) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
37' A long pass, executed by Andy Diouf (Lens), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
34' 1 - 1 Georges Mikautadze (Metz) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top left corner.
32' Wesley Said (Lens) is adjudged offside.
31' Florian Sotoca (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
29' The ball is out of play. Lens win a corner kick.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Wesley Said (Lens). The ball is out of play. Lens win a corner kick.
28' Ismael Traore (Metz) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
27' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
26' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick.
25' Wesley Said (Lens) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
22' Florian Sotoca (Lens) tries to find Wesley Said, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
21' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
18' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle as Ismael Traore (Metz) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
17' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
17' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pape Diallo (Metz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Metz force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' Deiver Machado (Lens) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
14' Wesley Said (Lens) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Florian Sotoca (Lens) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alexandre Oukidja into the bottom right corner.
13' Florian Sotoca (Lens) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
12' Wesley Said (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Lens! Great chance to score.
9' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
7' Florian Sotoca (Lens) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Wesley Said, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
4' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

3' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Ismael Traore (Metz) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
2' The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
2' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

2' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Brice Samba. The referee blows his whistle, Metz are awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Metz will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
